messages:
maya: FYI noticed a weird delta in the cost dashboard  cache savings showing -$0.05/1k for some routes after the dedicated-capacity rollout.
alex: negative cache savings? that's alarming. which tenant/route?
maya: tenant=beta-stores, route=/v1/chat/checkout-step
sam: classic symptom of double-amortization between prefetch and attribution. did the rollout change pool IDs or batch behavior?
jordan: rollout did introduce an amortize pass in router PR #4620 to reconcile prefetched credits when prefetched on dedicated pools.
alex: could be we're applying the amortization twice: once when prefetch writes a credit, and once in the per-batch attributor.
maya: here's the query I used to surface it:
```
SELECT route, tenant, sum(token_cost) AS token_cost, sum(cache_credit) AS cache_credit
FROM tokenlineage_daily
WHERE day = '2026-03-19' AND model_sku = 'redwood-large-4'
GROUP BY route, tenant
```
sam: i pulled some traces; in 40% of sampled requests the credit entry shows source=\"prefetch\" and later source=\"batch_amortize\" with the same credit id.
ops-bot: tracing sampling for tokenlineage was at 1%. Increased to 4% for routes >1k rps per earlier request.
alex: short-term mitigation: add a UI guard that floors cache savings at 0 for public view to avoid alarming customers, but keep an internal diagnostics column that surfaces the raw negative values.
jordan: agree. Also add a backend guard so a credit id is idempotent: if credit_id seen before for a request window, skip second application.
sam: can we also add a routing rule so prefetches triggered by dedicated-pool-prefetcher don't write amortized credits unless last-hotpath pool == prefetch.pool in last 10m? avoids cross-pool double-crediting.
maya: sketch for that logic?
jordan: pseudo:
```
if prefetch.pool == last_hotpath.pool OR time_since_last_hotpath < 10m:
  apply_credit(prefetch_credit)
else:
  log_prefetch_no_credit()
```
alex: rollout plan: 1) add UI floor + internal column behind LaunchDarkly flag; 2) backend idempotency + guard enabled via feature flag for 10% traffic; 3) increase lineage sampling while debugging; 4) full enable once tests pass.
sam: add a console alert: when cache_credit_per_1k < -0.02 for 2 consecutive windows -> create a ticket in #eng-platform (severity: low). Also log metric to econ-sim so we can run a regression.
maya: i'll make the console alert and the internal-only column. alex you take the UI PR?
alex: will do, aiming to open PR today EOD. will add tooltip: \"Internal diagnostics: negative cache savings may indicate double attribution.\"
jordan: creating INF-2193 to audit token-attributor and add unit tests for idempotency. assigning to me.
ops-bot: INF-2193 created. Tracing sampling increased to 4% for flagged routes.
sam: once we have the backend fix we should run an econ sim for multi-model chains, especially where quantized and full-precision models share a KV cache. negative cache could cascade into wrong routing decisions.
maya: agreed. follow ups: alex UI PR, jordan backend audit + unit tests, sam econ sim, maya console alert + internal column. tagging @alex @jordan @sam to sync on standup. :thumbsup:
alex: will post PR link here when ready. :rocket:
